lines.text: Many learners say: I study every days.

native.tip: Kita bilang “setiap hari” dengan satu kata hari. Di bahasa Inggris, setelah every juga satu kata: day, tanpa s.
native.caption: Pernah bilang begini? “I study every days.” 😅 Setelah every, pakai day tanpa s: “I study every day.” Dengarkan Kak Carlos, lalu ulangi! Latihan lagi di app Lexkite.
native.comment: Jawaban: “day”. Ucapkan dengan lantang: “I study every day.” lalu tulis satu hal yang kamu lakukan setiap hari. Latihan gratis lainnya di sini: {link}

en.tip: We say “setiap hari” with one word for day. In English, after every also use one word: day, with no s.
en.caption: Ever say this? “I study every days.” 😅 After every, use day with no s: “I study every day.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
